scope: Owned local setup only; no shared deployment performed.

incidents.action: A raw Convex CLI command ran from the repository instead of the private source snapshot, twice.
incidents.result: Each created an anonymous LOCAL3210 deployment. The CLI process exited; ports3210/3211 were confirmed closed and only the generated repository .env.local/.convex were removed.
incidents.correction: All subsequent deployment calls use deploy-revision-fixture.mjs with source, account, ownerPID, cwd, URL, environment and sourcehash guards.

incidents.action: A production build cleared .next containing this owner temporary fixture and preliminary reports.
incidents.result: Those preliminary reports were lost and were not used as final evidence.
incidents.correction: Moved fixture outside.next and reran backend, restore and HTTP verification; durable nonsecret reports are copied underdocs.

incidents.action: An early diagnostic printed local backend process arguments and an anonymous local configuration containing generated disposable instance credentials.
incidents.result: These were fixture credentials, not shared deployment credentials. The affected own fixture was removed; the #59 owner subsequently reported its separate fixture stopped and credentials deleted. No credential text was copied into committed reports, images or PR media.
incidents.correction: Subsequent process checks keep command strings internal and emit only owned PID/group/path checks. The cleanup record verifies no remaining own fixture processes.

sourceNote: This record supersedes the deleted .next/run.json pointer in the earlier decision row. The original decision row remains append-only.
